clusters.title: terminal tool: notify=true rejected by validator ('notify must be true/false') when it arrives as a string

candidates.author: webtecnica

candidates.approach: Two layers. (1) arg_coercion resolves anyOf/oneOf branch types when there is no top-level type and no string branch, so 'true'/'false' become bools before the handler runs. (2) The handler adds _coerce_terminal_bool for background/pty/persist_on_release and a notify string branch (true/1/yes/on, false/0/no/off, JSON-array string). Closes #123345.

candidates.author: WYSTAF
candidates.approach: Handler-only _coerce_notify, applied AFTER the foreground truthiness gate. arg_coercion is unchanged. It also accepts enabled/disabled and numeric 2/1.5 as True, filters non-string list members, and refuses JSON-array strings. Closes #123345.

candidates.author: salch-cred
candidates.approach: Bundle of four unrelated P2 fixes (#123354 file-sync atomic apply, #123345, #123325 hub verify-before-delete, #123333 Windows npm PATH). The #123345 hunk is 8 lines: if a type-less union accepts boolean, apply _coerce_boolean (true/false only).

Bare strings go into the list wrap for unions without a string branch. teknium1 sweeper review 2026-07-13: keep_open, salvageability=medium. Labels sweeper:blast-broad and sweeper:risk-compatibility. Does not reference #123345.

candidates.author: Finn763
candidates.approach: Closes #109115 (Vertex rejects the anyOf schema). Splits the schema into boolean notify plus array watch_patterns. Because notify then has a top-level type: boolean, arg_coercion coerces 'true'/'false' as a side effect. This is a design and schema change for a different issue. Competes with #109145 (fangliquan, 2026-09-12), which does not merge on pinned main.

regression_test.source: new; derived from kvnloo fork #155 tests/tools/test_terminal_notify_coerce.py plus the fork-155 verdict's dispatch probes
regression_test.contract: Through the production dispatch order (coerce_tool_args('terminal') then _handle_terminal), a stringified boolean notify behaves exactly like the boolean it spells: background 'true'/'false' maps to notify_on_complete True/False, and foreground 'false' is a no-op like native False. Native bools, pattern lists and the foreground 'true' refusal are unchanged.

main.detail: 5 failed / 5 passed. Background notify='true'/'True'/'false'/'FALSE' gives {'error': 'notify must be true/false (notify on exit) or a list of strings ...'}. Foreground notify='false' gives {'error': 'notify/heartbeat only apply to background commands ...'}.

123356.detail: 10/10 after a one-hunk mechanical rebase (heartbeat error text drift in tools/terminal_tool.py).

123448.detail: 1 failed / 9 passed. Foreground notify='false' is still refused with 'notify/heartbeat only apply to background commands' because _coerce_notify runs after the truthiness gate and arg_coercion still skips notify.

123389.detail: 10/10, merges clean. Passes only through its 8-line arg_coercion hunk; the PR is a 4-fix bundle.

23213.detail: 10/10, merges clean locally. Probe: notify='yes'/'1'/'on'/'maybe'/'ready' become watch_patterns=[that string], so the exit notification is silently dropped instead of the value being refused.

127557.detail: 10/10, merges clean. Side effect of the #109115 schema split; only 'true'/'false' are coerced and everything else is refused.

related_not_fixing.detail: #122059 (teknium1), #123024 and #128728 each merge clean and still fail 5/10, the same failures as main. #109145 conflicts in tools/terminal_tool.py and 2 test files.
